svg.aria-label: Axillary nerve sensory area and clinical correlations — 腋神经感觉区与临床对应

text.aria-label: Sensory territory and motor findings — 感觉区域与运动表现
text.tspan: Sensory territory and motor findings
感觉区域与运动表现

text.aria-label: Regimental badge area — 徽章区：腋神经的皮肤感觉分布
text.tspan: Regimental badge area
徽章区：腋神经的皮肤感觉分布

text.aria-label: Superior lateral cutaneous nerve of arm — 臂外上侧皮神经
text.tspan: Superior lateral cutaneous nerve of arm
臂外上侧皮神经

text.aria-label: A cutaneous branch of the Axillary nerve. — 腋神经发出的皮支。
text.tspan: A cutaneous branch of the Axillary nerve.
腋神经发出的皮支。

text.aria-label: Peripheral nerve territory ≠ dermatome. — 周围神经分布区不等同于皮节。
text.tspan: Peripheral nerve territory ≠ dermatome.
周围神经分布区不等同于皮节。

text.aria-label: The lateral upper arm overlaps the C5 dermatome. — 上臂外侧区域与 C5 皮节重叠。
text.tspan: The lateral upper arm overlaps the C5 dermatome.
上臂外侧区域与 C5 皮节重叠。

text.aria-label: Key myotomes · C5 and C6 — 代表性肌节 · 颈神经节段 C5、C6
text.tspan: Key myotomes · C5 and C6
代表性肌节 · 颈神经节段 C5、C6

text.aria-label: C5: shoulder abduction. C6: elbow flexion and wrist extension. — C5：肩外展；C6：屈肘和伸腕。
text.tspan: C5: shoulder abduction. C6: elbow flexion and wrist extension.
C5：肩外展；C6：屈肘和伸腕。

text.aria-label: These movements receive overlapping segmental contributions. — 这些动作通常接受相邻神经节段的共同支配。
text.tspan: These movements receive overlapping segmental contributions.
这些动作通常接受相邻神经节段的共同支配。

text.aria-label: Erb palsy · superior trunk (C5–C6) — Erb 麻痹 · 臂丛上干（C5–C6）
text.tspan: Erb palsy · superior trunk (C5–C6)
Erb 麻痹 · 臂丛上干（C5–C6）

text.aria-label: Weakness may involve Supraspinatus, Infraspinatus, Teres minor, — 可累及冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌、
text.tspan: Weakness may involve Supraspinatus, Infraspinatus, Teres minor,
可累及冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌、

text.aria-label: Deltoid and Biceps brachii. — 三角肌及肱二头肌。
text.tspan: Deltoid and Biceps brachii.
三角肌及肱二头肌。

text.aria-label: Typical “waiter’s tip” posture includes arm adduction and internal rotation. — 典型姿势包括上臂内收、内旋。
text.tspan: Typical “waiter’s tip” posture includes arm adduction and internal rotation.
典型姿势包括上臂内收、内旋。

text.aria-label: Peripheral nerve injury patterns — 周围神经损伤的表现
text.tspan: Peripheral nerve injury patterns
周围神经损伤的表现

text.aria-label: Axillary nerve injury: Deltoid weakness and badge-area sensory loss. — 腋神经损伤：三角肌无力和徽章区感觉减退。
text.tspan: Axillary nerve injury: Deltoid weakness and badge-area sensory loss.
腋神经损伤：三角肌无力和徽章区感觉减退。

text.aria-label: Risk: a surgical-neck fracture or an anterior shoulder dislocation. — 风险因素：肱骨外科颈骨折或肩关节前脱位。
text.tspan: Risk: a surgical-neck fracture or an anterior shoulder dislocation.
风险因素：肱骨外科颈骨折或肩关节前脱位。

text.aria-label: Long thoracic nerve: Serratus anterior weakness, winging and limited elevation. — 胸长神经损伤：前锯肌无力、翼状肩胛和上举困难。
text.tspan: Long thoracic nerve: Serratus anterior weakness, winging and limited elevation.
胸长神经损伤：前锯肌无力、翼状肩胛和上举困难。
